principle: ML-DSA signatures are too large for 3KB cards. Use detached or dual-sign design.

detached.description: PQ sig lives at sibling URL. Card carries only its SHA-256.

dual_sign.description: Ed25519 stays inline. ML-DSA produced alongside, fetched on demand.

raise_budget.description: Raise the 3KB budget. Changes every consumer.

library.name: @noble/post-quantum
library.platform: pure JS, no Node built-ins, Workers-compatible
library.caveat: Benchmark before committing — verify cost against Workers CPU budget

transition_plan: 2. Ed25519 stays inline in the card (current 3KB budget)
3. ML-DSA signature produced alongside, stored at sibling URL
4. Card carries the SHA-256 of the ML-DSA sig
6. Migrate historical cards to dual-signed (re-signed in bulk)
7. Update the public root to advertise both signatures
8. Maintain Ed25519 as fallback for 5+ years
